address: 3 place de la Monnaie, Nantes, 44000, France
bio: In his restaurant in the centre of Nantes, chef Jean-François Pantaléon expresses his passion for the produce of the Pays de Loire terroir. The wine list gives pride of place to hand-picked small-scale wine producers. The cosy interior and inviting, laid-back atmosphere further add to this delightful dining experience....
